verdict.rationale: Dagster's asset model lets you materialize or refresh a single asset/table without rerunning the whole pipeline (docs-1, docs-3/20 on checking if data needs refreshing), and the changelog shows explicit support for wiping/backfilling dynamic and multi-partitioned assets (docs-25), which is exactly the resync/backfill use case. However there's no dedicated backfill guide or hands-on account showing the workflow end-to-end. Missing for 10: an explicit backfill/partitions guide citation and independent user corroboration of doing a partial resync in practice.
